dedupe_keys.name: japan national land numerical information waste treatment facilities p15 廃棄物処理施設テータ

description: This dataset, layer P15 of Japan's National Land Numerical Information, gives the locations and attributes of municipal and industrial waste treatment facilities across Japan. It was prepared by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism from the Ministry of the Environment's survey of municipal waste treatment and from prefectural and city lists of industrial waste facilities, by geocoding facility addresses and checking each position against 1:25,000 maps. Each point carries the facility name, the local government that manages it, facility type code and type, treatment capacity in tonnes per day, indoor and outdoor storage areas and, for final disposal sites, total capacity. The latest version is fiscal year 2012, covering all prefectures, and is distributed as GML (JPGIS 2.1) and shapefile zip files per prefecture in the JGD2000 coordinate system. Downloads are free, but the terms of use for this layer mark it non-commercial. Caveats: the data are more than a decade old, positions are representative points, and industrial facility coverage depends on what each prefecture published. Simulation uses: mapping waste treatment and landfill capacity for disaster waste planning after earthquakes and floods, checking facility exposure to tsunami and flood zones, and building the network of plants for waste flow models. Related records: the Ministry of the Environment's municipal waste treatment survey (data-japan-municipal-waste-treatment-survey) is the statistical source, and the National Land Numerical Information portal (data-japan-mlit-national-land-numerical-information) holds the other layers.
